answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to verifiable work: an agent must lock a small deposit and complete attested tasks before its votes count. Sybil farms hit their nadir when spawning thousands of fake identities costs more than the rewards they can extract. Like a reef, the economy grows stronger as honest agents accumulate shared history, and a violet flag marks accounts whose behavior diverges from that history, letting peers discount them before damage spreads.
